name: QuickSTRM
description: Zero-touch .strm management, playback acceleration, and *arr orchestration suite for Jellyfin 10.11+. Eliminates remote ffprobe latency with instant-start playback, provisions authenticated Radarr/Sonarr/Whisparr webhooks, auto-heals dead 404 links, pre-warms next episodes for Fire TV Stick 4K / Astra clients, and protects low-power hardware with debounced SQLite I/O and deferred chapter synthesis.
overview: Zero-touch .strm playback acceleration, *arr orchestration, 404 auto-healing, and next-episode pre-warming suite for Jellyfin.

versions.changelog:
Zero-Touch *arr Orchestration, 404 Auto-Healing & Low-Power Hardware Safeguards (v1.1.0)

Zero-Touch *arr Suite Integration:
- Automated Webhook Provisioning: Discovers and configures authenticated webhooks inside Radarr, Sonarr, and Whisparr with query string security tokens (?token=...).
- Startup Retry Loop: 5-attempt exponential backoff retry loop (10s, 20s, 40s, 80s, 160s) resolves container startup race conditions.
- Clean Teardown: Single-click 'Wipe All *arr Webhooks' safely deletes all QuickSTRM webhooks on uninstall.
- Synchronous Override: Segregated SyncSingleInstanceAsync prevents Jellyfin UI freezes during manual sync attempts.

Autonomous 'Auto-Heal on 404' Pipeline:
- Dead Link Detection: Intercepts deterministic HTTP 404 errors and dead cloud mount links.
- Mount Guard Verification: Ancestor mount marker validation (.mount_ok) prevents accidental mass purges when cloud remotes drop.
- Reverse Path Translation: Translates Jellyfin mount paths to external *arr schemes (PathTo -> PathFrom).
- Auto Deletion & Search: Deletes dead file records in Radarr/Sonarr and triggers immediate replacement searches (EpisodeSearch, SeriesSearch, MoviesSearch) across Usenet and Torrent indexers.

Hardware & Playback Safeguards (Intel Core i3 / Low-Spec Hosts):
- Debounced SQLite I/O with 50ms Pacing: Batches file system monitor reports with 50ms delays, preventing database write-locks during bulk season downloads.
- Deferred Virtual Chapter Synthesis: Delays 5-minute virtual chapter creation to PlaybackStopped, keeping disk I/O completely idle during initial video playback start.
- Next-Episode Pre-Warming: Intercepts playback start and proactively pre-probes the next sequential episode in the High Priority lane, eliminating buffering freezes for binge-watching on streaming clients (Fire TV Stick 4K, Astra, Apple TV).

UI & Repository Upgrades:
- Native Sidebar Elevation: Plugin elevated to main Jellyfin navigation sidebar with Material Design bolt icon.
- Dynamic Status Badges: Displays Synced (green) and Unsynced/Error (red) badges with live DOM updates.
- Purged Legacy Scripts: Completely deleted obsolete host bash scripts in favor of 100% in-process orchestration.
